messages:
sophia-partnerships: Hey team — quick sync on the AsterAI onboarding. Legal sent over a first pass of the distro + commercial usage clauses. We need alignment on (1) hosting/redistribution rights (2) attribution / logos for press, and (3) payout structure for marketplace listings. Any red lines?
raj-legal: Thanks. High-level: AsterAI wants permissive use for customers but a clause preventing downstream resale of raw weights. They also asked for no attribution requirement in product UI, only press/marketing. :thinking_face:
liam-engineering: Tech note: if we allow hosting of quantized variants on Redwood Dedicated, we need an explicit clause permitting creation and distribution of quantized/converted artifacts. Otherwise ops can't package them. Also curious about KMS / checkpoint transfer for Private deployments.
diana-bizdev: Our commercial stance: allow hosting (hosted + dedicated) with a revenue-share for marketplace/managed hosting; prohibit redistribution of raw checkpoint blobs outside partner channels. We should push for a modest minimum guarantee if they want preferential marketplace placement.
emma-ops: For joint announcements, AsterAI asked for a 48h embargo after review. They also want staged artwork (logo, model card) and a lead contact for launch ops. Can we provide staging assets from our side?
raj-legal: Draft clause suggestion:

```
Allowed Uses: Licensee may host, serve, and provide access to Model Variants (including quantized or converted forms) to End Users via Redwood's platform. Redistribution of raw model checkpoints or un-forked weight files is prohibited without prior written consent.
Attribution: Partner may request attribution in press and marketing materials only; no in-product UI attribution is required.
```

Thoughts?
liam-engineering: That covers the technical bit. Add a line about signing encrypted transfer receipts when we deliver production checkpoints to Private deployments (for audit).
raj-legal: Good catch. I'll add: "Delivery audit: all checkpoint transfers to customer-controlled environments must be accompanied by signed transfer manifests and KMS-wrapped keys." 

Also: what about fine-tuning rights? AsterAI wants customers to be able to fine-tune on our hosted infra.
diana-bizdev: We should allow hosted fine-tuning but restrict export of fine-tuned weights unless revenue-share applies or they opt into an enterprise redistribution add-on.
sophia-partnerships: Sounds like we have a working position. Action items:
- raj-legal to produce an amendment template by EOD Tue (1755518500) :white_check_mark:
- liam to document packaging requirements for quantized variants + manifest format by Fri
- emma to confirm staging asset timeline with AsterAI and secure logo files
- diana to propose revenue-share bands and minimum guarantee ranges

Can everyone ack and add questions here? :pray:
liam-engineering: ack. I'll include a sample manifest spec (sha256, quant params, provenance).
emma-ops: ack. I'll ping Aster contact Karen and request assets + embargo confirmation.
raj-legal: ack — I'll drop a redline and share in #legal-review.
diana-bizdev: ack. I'll model 20/15/10 tiers with a $5k/mo MG as starting strawman.
legal-bot: Reminder: route any redlines to legal@redwood.com and include "AsterAI distro" in subject for tracking.
sophia-partnerships: Perfect. If no other blockers, I'll run this into the partner playbook and sync on Thursday.
